query: How does your company make sure that only the right people can get into important systems and data? Access requests follow a formal approval workflow, and all access is logged and monitored. We conduct regular, at least annual, access reviews to validate that existing permissions remain appropriate and remove any unnecessary access. Upon an employee's departure or role change, access is promptly revoked or adjusted according to established procedures. Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all critical systems.
